scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @sunshine/contracts && npm run build -w @sunshine/api && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @sunshine/api" "npm run dev -w @sunshine/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @sunshine/contracts && npm run build -w @sunshine/web && npm run build -w @sunshine/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sunshine/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sunshine/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run db:validate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
